name: month-end-accounting-pack
description: On the 1st of every month, prepares last month's orders, refunds, payouts and tax by country as CSV files and a one-page PDF summary, and emails your accountant the links once you approve.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: The 1st of every month, early morning

howItWorks.label: Exports
howItWorks.text: Last month's orders and refunds as CSV files your accountant can open in Excel

howItWorks.label: Summarises
howItWorks.text: Sales, refunds, tax by country and payouts on one PDF page, with anything that doesn't add up

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the email to your accountant with the links (needs Resend)

plugins.reason: Emails the pack to your accountant once you approve it
Adds Shopify Payments payouts and fees, to check them against sales
Adds PayPal transactions, fees and refunds

data.description: The order number your accountant will see
When the order was placed or paid
The order's total paid amount, including tax and shipping
Tax (VAT, sales tax) charged on the order
The country the order ships or is billed to, for tax by country
The order's currency, when the store sells in more than one
The order's status, to leave out test and cancelled orders
Refunds: amount, date and the order they belong to
How the order was paid (card, PayPal, bank transfer), to match payouts

parameters.label: When to run
parameters.description: 06:00 on the 1st of every month by default

parameters.label: Time zone
parameters.description: Used for the schedule and for where last month starts and ends

parameters.label: Accountant's email
parameters.description: Leave empty to get the pack in the run only, without an email

parameters.label: Reply-to address
parameters.description: Where your accountant's replies should go, e.g. your own inbox

parameters.label: Store name
parameters.description: Used in the email and on the summary
